sections.heading: Enterprise API Documentation
sections.content:
# Enterprise API Documentation

Base URL: `https://mock-api-server-seven.vercel.app/api/v1`

---

sections.heading: Contracts API
sections.content: ## Contracts API

sections.heading: Get All Contracts
sections.content:
### Get All Contracts

**Endpoint:** `GET /contracts`

**Description:** Returns a list of all contracts. Supports filtering by query parameters.

**Filterable Fields:**

- `contractNumber` — Filter by contract number
- `clientName` — Filter by client name (partial match, case-insensitive)
- `productName` — Filter by product name (partial match, case-insensitive)
- `contractStatus` — Filter by status: `Active`, `Inactive`, `Surrendered`
- `taxType` — Filter by tax type: `Qualified`, `Non-Qualified`
- `taxQualification` — Filter by qualification: `IRA`, `ROTH IRA`, `NON-QUAL`
- `distributionCompany` — Filter by distribution company

**Example Requests:**

```
GET /contracts
GET /contracts?contractStatus=Active
GET /contracts?taxType=Qualified
GET /contracts?productName=ASSETSHIELD 5
GET /contracts?contractStatus=Active&taxType=Qualified
```

**Response:**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Request successful",
  "data": [
    {
      "contractNumber": "1561091",
      "clientName": "NETTING AETEST",
      "productName": "AMERICAN EQUITY ASSETSHIELD 5 FIXED INDEX ANNUITY",
      "issuedDate": "2026-06-17T05:00:00+00:00",
      "currentValue": 0,
      "anniversaryDate": "2027-06-17T05:00:00+00:00",
      "taxType": "Qualified",
      "contractStatus": "Active",
      "taxQualification": "IRA",
      "distributionCompany": "AELife"
    }
  ],
  "timestamp": "2026-07-27T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

---

sections.heading: Get Contract by Number
sections.content:
### Get Contract by Number

**Endpoint:** `GET /contracts/:contractNumber`

**Description:** Returns a single contract by its contract number.

**Path Parameters:**

- `contractNumber` (string, required) — The contract number

**Example Request:**

```
GET /contracts/1561091
```

**Success Response:**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Request successful",
  "data": {
    "contractNumber": "1561091",
    "clientName": "NETTING AETEST",
    "productName": "AMERICAN EQUITY ASSETSHIELD 5 FIXED INDEX ANNUITY",
    "issuedDate": "2026-06-17T05:00:00+00:00",
    "currentValue": 0,
    "anniversaryDate": "2027-06-17T05:00:00+00:00",
    "taxType": "Qualified",
    "contractStatus": "Active",
    "taxQualification": "IRA",
    "distributionCompany": "AELife"
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-07-27T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

**Not Found Response (404):**

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Contract 9999999 not found",
  "data": null,
  "timestamp": "2026-07-27T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

---

sections.heading: Applications API
sections.content: ## Applications API

sections.heading: Get All Applications
sections.content:
### Get All Applications

**Endpoint:** `GET /applications`

**Description:** Returns a list of all applications. Supports filtering by query parameters.

**Filterable Fields:**

- `clientName` — Filter by client name (partial match, case-insensitive)
- `product` — Filter by product name (partial match, case-insensitive)
- `taxType` — Filter by tax type: `Qualified`, `Non-Qualified`
- `status` — Filter by status: `In Progress`, `Submitted`, `Approved`, `Rejected`
- `contractNumber` — Filter by contract number
- `productId` — Filter by product ID
- `agentNumber` — Filter by agent number
- `contactId` — Filter by contact ID
- `applicationName` — Filter by application name (partial match, case-insensitive)
- `startDate` — Filter by start date (partial match, e.g., `2026-07-15`)

**Example Requests:**

```
GET /applications
GET /applications?status=In Progress
GET /applications?product=ESTATESHIELD
GET /applications?agentNumber=2026
GET /applications?applicationName=JOHNSON
GET /applications?startDate=2026-07
GET /applications?status=Approved&taxType=Qualified
```

**Response:**

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Request successful",
  "data": [
    {
      "clientName": "sdf sdf",
      "product": "AMERICAN EQUITY ESTATESHIELD 10 FIXED INDEX ANNUITY",
      "anticipatedPremium": 99999,
      "startDate": "2026-07-15T13:27:11.782+00:00",
      "taxType": "Non-Qualified",
      "status": "In Progress",
      "contractNumber": "1561438",
      "productId": "I-ESTATE24",
      "agentNumber": "2026",
      "applicationLink": "https://american-equity-uatx.unqork.io/app/application#/display/application?id=6a5789ec1ce36757d331b5b8",
      "contactId": "482354",
      "applicationName": "sdf sdf Application"
    }
  ],
  "timestamp": "2026-07-27T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

---

sections.heading: Common Response Structure
sections.content:
## Common Response Structure

All API responses follow this consistent format:

```json
{
  "success": true | false,
  "message": "string",
  "data": object | array | null,
  "timestamp": "ISO 8601 string"
}
```

sections.heading: Error Responses
sections.content:
## Error Responses

| Status Code | Meaning               |
| ----------- | --------------------- |
| 200         | Success               |
| 404         | Resource not found    |
| 400         | Bad request           |
| 500         | Internal server error |

---

sections.heading: Filtering Behavior
sections.content:
## Filtering Behavior

- All filters use **AND** logic (all conditions must match)
- Matching is **case-insensitive**
- Matching supports **partial match** (contains)
- Empty or undefined filter values are **ignored**
- Multiple filters can be combined: `?status=Active&taxType=Qualified`

sections.content:
# Beneficiary Management

Policy owners may add, remove or update beneficiaries.

Required information:

- Full Name
- Relationship
- Date of Birth
- Percentage Allocation

Changes become effective after successful verification.

5. Submit the claim.

# Items to Take Over the Phone

2

Considerations:
Joint Ownership:
• For TOVs, LIBR Resets, and Address Changes:
o If joint owners are spouses, only one is required to be on the phone to make a request
o If joint owners are not spouses, both owners are required to be on the phone to make a request
• For all other tasks:
o Both owners are required to be on the phone to make a request/update
Spousal Consent:
• If ‘Yes’ is stated in the below table, please ask to speak to the client’s spouse. Confirm the spouse’s
name and that they are okay with the request.
o If the spouse is not available, we cannot complete the request over the phone. The client
can call back later with their spouse, or we can send a form to have completed and signed
by both spouses.
NIGO Items:
• Verify the information that was missing from the form with the client
• Complete a new form with all the required information
o This does not apply to tax withholding changes. If client is wanting to change their tax withholding
only, Create a Task in Infinitie. No new form is needed.
• Upload/Prod Image new form to workflow (OPUS or Infinitie depending upon department) for processing
• Note the contract
• New Business Items to Take Over the Phone vs Corrections
Requests to Cancel a Processing Request:
• If a request was initiated by the agent (who was authorized to make the request on behalf of the client),
either the agent or client can request to cancel the request. If the agent cancels, a quick callout must be
made to the client to confirm before cancelling.
• If the client initiated the request, only the client can cancel the request
Service Only Agents:
• Agents with a Service Only Agreement can take all actions on contracts as agents indicated by the chart
below so long as they retain an active status

Yes.

Monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual payment options are available.

# SecureLife Plus Insurance

SecureLife Plus is a flexible life insurance product designed to provide long-term financial protection.

sections.heading: SecureLife Plus Insurance — Features (product-guide.md)
sections.content:
## Features

- Flexible premium payment options
- Lifetime death benefit
- Optional accidental death rider
- Cash value accumulation
- Online policy management

sections.heading: SecureLife Plus Insurance — Eligibility (product-guide.md)
sections.content:
## Eligibility

- Minimum age: 18 years
- Maximum age: 65 years

sections.heading: SecureLife Plus Insurance — Policy Term (product-guide.md)
sections.content:
## Policy Term

Coverage continues until age 99 provided premiums are paid.

# Transferring Calls to Another Area

2
Back to Top
Agent Locator Program
Client requesting a new agent, whether they have an active existing agent or not Reference
the Agent Locator Program Procedure to complete form.
Sales Transfers
Agents calling on future/potential business or for reasons noted in the next bulleted
section can be transferred to AE Sales, AN Sales, EL Sales or AE of NY Sales queues.
Verify agents following standard verification procedures, including but not limited to, agent
number or social security number.
• For agents not currently active, Customer Excellence should try to assist; however, if
the caller has questions regarding their license status, transfer them to the Agency
Team.
• For calls regarding technical issues, including systems not performing, please
submit a Solutions Portal ticket for IT review. Do not transfer to Sales.
Calls regarding the following can be transferred to Sales:
• Advertising Templates and Ad Slicks
• Agents who are not currently appointed and would like to learn about our products
with the intent to sell.
• MyPortal and other public facing website/software, including:
o Assistance in Navigation
o Assistance in completing an illustration
o Assistance in completing a ReadyApp application
o Requesting access to view commission statements
o Requesting access to see list of active clients in MyPortal
o Assistance finding Marketing or Sales materials
• Agents who want to discuss an email received from Marketing@american-
equity.com
• Agent questions regarding their year-to-date production statistics
• Agent supply requests
• Business who wants to become an IMO (direct contract) with American Equity
• General questions regarding American Equity
• General Commission questions
o Contract specific commission questions should be transferred to the Agency
Team. See below for Agency Team Transfers.
• Historical credit rates, interest rates, or earnings information that is not contract
specific

sections.heading: Transferring Calls to Another Area (transferring-calls-to-another-area.pdf)
sections.content:
# Transferring Calls to Another Area

3
Back to Top
o Contract specific questions regarding annual statements, rates, or earnings
should be researched and handled by Customer Excellence
• Illustrations for contracts not yet issued
o Illustrations for in-force contracts will be handled by Customer Excellence
• Loyalty Rewards Program (formerly Gold Eagle Program), Partner Conference,
agent events, contests, incentives, gifts received, etc.
• New product information
• Product training
• Questions regarding the Client Appreciation Luncheon
• Review of sales materials
In addition to calls from Agents, contract holders may call regarding sales materials. This is
because the introductory letter for new contract holders includes the below paragraph:
If a client calls in requesting the sales materials because their agent did not provide them
during the sales process, transfer the call to marketing or if the request was written, email
sales@american-equity.com. In the email, let them know that the client is requesting sales
material for their contract. Include the product that the contract was issued with and
contract number.
Marketing will send all requested sales brochures to the client.
Agency Transfers
Calls regarding the following requests go to the applicable Agency queue:
• Agents or uplines asking about debit balances, charge backs, or commissions.
• Agents or uplines asking about transfers, contract changes, or licensing information
• Eagle Life block transfers from one broker dealer to another
• Agent unable to see their book of business on the agent website
o Confirm if contract is issued or not. If not issued, it will not display. Reference
the Pending Business not Showing on Agent Website procedure.
• Requests to remove an agent
• Agent change request in OPUS

sections.content:
# Transferring Calls to Another Area

4
Back to Top
Customer Excellence Calls
Calls regarding the following requests can be handled by Post Production Client team
members (Post Issue queue):
• Most servicing tasks and questions unless otherwise noted
• Potential client looking to open a contract
• Annuitization quotes
• Concierge Agents
o Are provided a 5 digit access code to use when calling into the Concierge
phone line. If the incoming phone number or code is not recognized, the
interaction will be routed to the main agent phone line.
o If a call is received from a Concierge agent or assistant, assist them by
following standard procedures, do not transfer them to the Concierge line.
o Send an email to the Concierge Manager, with the policy number, agent
name, a brief recap of the call, and if a follow-up is needed.
• Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) Calls, transfer to the Password Reset queue.
o Select the applicable Skill from the drop-down list for the Password Reset
queue.
▪ AEL Password Reset
▪ Eagle Life Password Reset
▪ AEL of NY Password Reset
New Business Transfers
Calls regarding the following requests go to the New Business Team (Agent-Pre Issue
queue):
• Questions on pending/incomplete cases
• Free look cancels and delivery receipts
• Request for paperwork regarding transfers into American Equity
• Adding additional funds
• Internal rollover paperwork
Company Code 06
• The contract number begin with Y or NY
• Calls regarding NY cases should be transferred to NY Post Issue queue.
Solutions Transfers

sections.heading: Transferring Calls to Another Area (transferring-calls-to-another-area.pdf)
sections.content:
# Transferring Calls to Another Area

5
Back to Top
Calls regarding the following requests go to the Solutions queue or email them at
solutionsrequests@american-equity.com:
• Premium refunds/over-contributions
o We need a signed and dated Letter of Instruction (LOI) from the customer. If
an LOI is on file, then Solutions will be able to assist. If not, please advise the
caller to submit an LOI.
• Reissue requests
• Cost basis corrections
Claims Transfers
Calls regarding the following requests go to the Claims queue:
• All pending death claim questions.
• Contracts ending in a “S” (Stretch) and “D” (Deferred)
Resolutions
• If the caller wants to file a complaint about an agent or product:
o The complaint must be in writing. The complaint may be faxed, mailed, or
emailed.
o Once the complaint is received, it will be handled in the Resolution Team.
o Once a caller has notified you that a complaint is going to be filed, email your
Manager.
▪ The Manager will forward the email to a leader on the Resolution
Team as a heads-up that a complaint is being filed.
• If a caller mentions that an attorney will be getting involved, try to transfer the call
to Resolutions. If you are unable to get someone on the phone, please send an email
to your Manager right away regarding the phone call.
Suitability Transfers
Calls from agents or uplines regarding the following should be transferred to the Suitability
queue.
• Questions on files that are pending Suitability review.
• Reasons for Suitability decisions on declines or approvals that were modified
Life Policies
• Please transfer all Life and Cancer policies to the Life Group/Entrada.

sections.heading: Transferring Calls to Another Area (transferring-calls-to-another-area.pdf)
sections.content:
# Transferring Calls to Another Area

6
Back to Top
o Life insurance hours are Monday thru Thursday, 8:00am-5:00pm, Fridays
8:00am-1:00pm via 888-647-1373.
▪ If the Life group cannot be reached due to outside of business hours,
take a detailed message and email the life group.
▪ Inform the caller a return phone call is generally returned between
24-48 business hours. Do not reach out to the Life Group team
members directly.
o During office hours, incoming calls to the Life Entrada line which are not
answered within 1 minute will route to a Life voicemail.
• Life policies can be Company 01, Company 02, or Company 17.
o Life policies on Company 01 begin with a “L00.”
o Policies that begin with “L9” are Fidelity Investment policies, and clients
should call Fidelity at 800-343-3548 for assistance.
o Life Policies on Company 02 can be any different policy number type.
▪ All Cancer policies will be Company 02.
▪ All policies for Company 02 should be forwarded to the Life Group.
o Life policies on Company 17, also known as Entrada, can be a long series of
numbers.
▪ All policies for Company 17 should be forwarded to the Life Group.
• Life policies can be National Guard or Fire Fighter policies. Any mention of National
Guard or Fire Fighters can be transferred to the Life Group.
• All processing tasks for Life policies (individual or group) as well as Cancer policies.
Their group email is life@american-equity.com.
FAST – FlexShield 10
• Contract number includes an F
• Pre-Production queue: FAST Pre Issue
• Post-Production queue: FAST Post Issue
